title: تكلفة الإعلان على لينكد إن 2026: دليل الاستثمار لا الإنفاق

images.dalle_prompt: A modern, cinematic 16:9 featured cover image for an executive B2B marketing guide on LinkedIn Ads cost and ROI. In the center, a futuristic floating 3D holographic command dashboard displaying live LinkedIn Campaign Manager metrics: 'ROAS: 4.8x' in radiant emerald green, 'Closed Enterprise Deals: $185,000', and glowing conversion charts. Beside the dashboard, a luxury 3D crystal and gold chess King piece stands majestically on a sleek reflective digital surface, symbolizing high-level strategic decision-making. Background is an executive glass penthouse overlooking a glowing modern metropolis skyline at dusk. Deep LinkedIn blue (#0077B5), cyber emerald, and warm champagne gold accents. Elegant modern Arabic typography prominently integrated at the top in glowing white and gold: 'تكلفة إعلانات لينكد إن 2026: استثمار ذكي لا إنفاق'. In the bottom corner: 'khatwatuk.com | خطواتك'. Photorealistic 8k render, cinematic lighting.

images.role: الصورة الفرعية الأولى (استراتيجية صيد الحيتان والاستهداف الجراحي)
images.dalle_prompt: A sophisticated 3D visual concept representing Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and Precision Targeting on LinkedIn. A high-tech digital targeting radar beam with precision crosshairs homing in on holographic 3D corporate executive profiles (CEOs, Founders, Directors) labeled with golden verification badges, while automatically filtering out unqualified leads through glowing dynamic data filters. A luminous golden conversion funnel channels high-value B2B deals directly into signed digital contracts. Ultra-clean tech aesthetic, deep navy blue, neon cyan, and brushed gold highlights. Premium Arabic typography overlay at the top: 'استراتيجية صيد الحيتان (ABM): استهداف صنّاع القرار'. Small subtitle: 'كيف تخفض تكلفة الاستحواذ وتضاعف الأرباح'. In the corner: 'khatwatuk.com | خطواتك'. 8k resolution, masterpiece.
